build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake by running pip install in the project root directory
build_gtn_extension: build a single gtn CMake extension module such as gtn._graph or gtn._autograd via setup.py
configure_cmake_build: configure the cmake build with python bindings enabled and examples benchmarks and tests disabled
validate_cmake_version: validate that cmake version 3.5.1 or higher is installed before building gtn extensions
load_readme_description: load the README.md file content to use as the long description for the gtn package
